# Fountage extensions on Slint 1.18.1

Vendored from the locally installed crates.io package. Upstream source and LICENSES are retained; FOUNTAGE_ORIGINAL_FILES.json records original file hashes. No registry files were modified.

Feature fountage-ime adds fountage_ime.rs, exports it from lib.rs, stores state on WindowInner, and routes composition before ordinary key normalization. Cargo.toml declares the feature. A further accessibility correction in textlayout/sharedparley/accessibility.rs appends the exact source LF/CRLF separator instead of always emitting LF. Its small accessibility/separator.rs helper is compiled unchanged into the app regression suite through a test-only path module. The FocusScope focus_event implementation in items/input_items.rs also processes FocusOut while disabled, clearing stale has_focus before re-entry; new focus while disabled remains rejected. Feature fountage-styled-text adds a validated StyledText::from_spans constructor and StyledTextSpan in styled_text.rs. Other upstream files are unchanged. This is a Fountage extension, not upstream public Slint API. The prototype pins the exact runtime version and patches only its dependency graph.

The bridge is disabled unless a handler and matching custom-focus owner enable it. It never routes composition from a different item; disabling it preserves a newly focused stock TextInput. Properties use committed UTF8 source offsets and logical window candidate geometry. Advanced replacement/cursor/partial events require application mapping and acceptance tests.

To upgrade, replace this package with the new upstream version, reapply/review the small patch and rerun standard/custom IME, focus, dialog, candidate and native tests. Do not infer compatibility from semver.

Accessibility acceptance: native CRLF selection request for Zoë selected ait before this correction and Zoë afterward. Replacement/Undo and mixed-ending CJK/emoji selection verified. Exact64-byte mixed-ending/decomposed-accent native SaveCopy verified. This does not certify the custom formatted editor accessibility tree or every text-marker/VoiceOver operation. Regression helper covers separator values/cluster byte lengths/geometry-array consistency; native backend transport is checked separately.

Styled preview extension: the upstream Rust API creates StyledText from plain text or Markdown, but does not expose construction from semantic style ranges. Fountage already has rendered text and UTF16 emphasis ranges from its Rust screenplay engine. Re-parsing that output as Markdown can reinterpret literal HTML/links/punctuation and underline semantics. The opt-in constructor accepts only validated UTF8 byte ranges plus bold/italic/underline flags, produces native StyledText paragraphs with no links and never parses or rewrites the text. Empty spans are skipped; invalid or out-of-bounds ranges reject before construction. The application converts the engine’s rendered UTF16 coordinates, labels preview text for accessibility and reports validation failure with a plain-text fallback. This is pinned Fountage API, not an upstream capability. Review this sixth modified upstream file on upgrades along with existing IME/focus/accessibility patches. Actual raster and literal-text tests cover the new path.
